description: Native CI confirmation of indexed allocation registry/direct unlinking. Complete unmodified schema-3 timing reports preserve generated inputs, all samples, dispersion, order, build/driver/executable hashes and host metadata. Timings include startup without subtraction.

audit.windows_line_endings: Collector, short-source and template/kernel hashes match CRLF checkout bytes; generated-source hashes match LF bytes. Content agrees with local inputs.
audit.limits: Comparisons are paired with pre-Phase-2, not the immediately preceding indexed-registry baseline. Prior CI runs remain separate; cross-run differences do not isolate this repair.
